author: Noesis III
title: Portfolio4 SA‑LP (4×240s multistart + 240s polish + persistent record)
abstract: Runs four SA‑LP searches (240s each) from hex seeds with different RNG seeds, selects the best, then applies a 240s SA‑LP polish. Writes the final centers/radii to lineage storage for reproducibility. Total ≈1200s.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, os, time, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp as M

def ensure_dir(p):
    os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)

def save_npz(path, centers, radii, meta):
    ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(path))
    np.savez_compressed(path, centers=centers, radii=radii, **meta)

def construct_packing():
    seeds = [20251021, 20251022, 20251023, 20251024]
    per_run = 240.0   # seconds per seed
    polish = 240.0    # final polish on best
    best_ctrs = None
    best_r = None
    best_s = -1.0
    best_seed = None

    for sd in seeds:
        ctrs0 = M.hex_centers_26()
        ctrs, r, s = M.sa_optimize(ctrs0, budget_sec=per_run, seed=sd)
        if s > best_s:
            best_s, best_ctrs, best_r, best_seed = s, ctrs, r, sd

    ctrs_final, r_final, s_final = M.sa_optimize(best_ctrs, budget_sec=polish, seed=best_seed)

    # Persist result
    ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", time.gmtime())
    out_path = f"storage/noesis/pack/runs/portfolio4_{ts}.npz"
    save_npz(out_path, ctrs_final, r_final, {"best_seed": best_seed, "score": float(s_final)})

    # Validity checks
    x, y = ctrs_final[:,0], ctrs_final[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r_final > 0)
    assert np.all(r_final <= b + 1e-9)
    return ctrs_final, r_final
